title: Leveraging Discrete Function Decomposability for Scientific Design
abstract: arXiv:2511.03032v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the era of AI-driven science and engineering, we often want to design discrete objects in silico according to user-specified properties. For example, we may wish to design a protein to bind its target, arrange components within a circuit to minimize latency, or find materials with certain properties. Given a property predictive model, in silico design typically involves training a generative model over the design space (e.g., protein sequence space) to concentrate on designs with the desired properties. Distributional optimization$\unicode{x2013}$which can be formalized as an estimation of distribution algorithm or as reinforcement learning policy optimization$\unicode{x2013}$finds the generative model that maximizes an objective function in expectation. translated_title: 利用离散函数可分解性进行科学设计
translated_abstract: 在AI驱动的科学与工程时代，我们常常希望根据用户指定的属性在计算机中设计离散对象。例如，我们可能希望设计一种能与靶标结合的蛋白质，排列电路中的组件以最小化延迟，或寻找具有特定性质的材料。在给定属性预测模型的情况下，计算机辅助设计通常需要在设计空间（如蛋白质序列空间）上训练一个生成模型，使其聚焦于具有所需属性的设计。分布优化——其可以被形式化为分布估计算法或强化学习策略优化——旨在寻找在期望意义上最大化目标函数的生成模型。由于设计空间的组合特性，对离散值设计上的分布进行优化在总体上具有挑战性。然而，科学领域中的许多属性预测器（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用科学中属性预测函数所具有的离散可分解结构，将离散设计空间上的分布优化问题分解为更易处理的子问题，从而更高效地设计满足用户指定属性的离散对象（如蛋白质、电路和材料）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes leveraging the decomposable structure of scientific property predictors to make distributional optimization over discrete design spaces more tractable, enabling efficient in silico design of discrete objects such as proteins, circuits, and materials with desired properties.
